get-current.name: get-current
get-current.description: Get current date and time in specified timezone. Returns a rich JSON with ISO, Unix timestamps, human-readable, weekday, etc. Optionally format with a custom format string.

params.format: Optional output format. Accepts Luxon tokens ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') or Moment.js tokens ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss'). If omitted, returns rich JSON.

format.name: format
format.description: Format a date/time string. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps (seconds or ms), and common formats. Supports both Luxon and Moment.js format tokens.

params.datetime: Date/time to format. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms, as string or number), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.
params.format: Output format. Luxon tokens ('yyyy-MM-dd', 'HH:mm:ss', 'cccc, d LLLL yyyy') or Moment.js tokens ('YYYY-MM-DD', 'dddd, D MMMM YYYY').
params.inputFormat: Explicit input format (Luxon tokens) if auto-detection fails (optional)
params.timezone: Target timezone for output (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). Defaults to keeping the input's timezone.

parse.name: parse
parse.description: Parse a date/time string into structured data. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, and common formats. Returns rich JSON with all representations.

params.datetime: Date/time to parse. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.
params.format: Explicit input format (Luxon tokens) if auto-detection fails (optional)
params.timezone: Target timezone for output (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). Defaults to keeping the input's timezone.

convert-timezone.name: convert-timezone
convert-timezone.description: Convert a date/time between timezones. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, and common formats. Returns rich JSON for both source and target.

params.datetime: Date/time to convert. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.
params.fromTimezone: Source timezone (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). If input is a Unix timestamp, this is ignored (always UTC).

add.name: add
add.description: Add duration to a date/time. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, and common formats.

params.datetime: Base date/time. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.
params.timezone: Timezone for output (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). Defaults to keeping the input's timezone.

subtract.name: subtract
subtract.description: Subtract duration from a date/time. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, and common formats.

params.datetime: Base date/time. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp (seconds or ms), RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.
params.timezone: Timezone for output (e.g., 'Europe/Madrid'). Defaults to keeping the input's timezone.

diff.name: diff
diff.description: Calculate difference between two dates. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, and common formats.

params.start: Start date/time. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp, RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.
params.end: End date/time. Accepts: ISO 8601, Unix timestamp, RFC 2822, SQL, or common formats.

is-valid.name: is-valid
is-valid.description: Validate a date/time string. Accepts ISO 8601, Unix timestamps, RFC 2822, SQL, and common formats. Returns whether it parses and what it parses to.

params.format: Explicit input format (Luxon tokens) to test against (optional)

name: DateTime
description: Date and time utilities with timezone support. Provides clock, calendar, and time conversion tools.

changelog.notes: Fix: rewrite on @teros/mca-sdk McaServer — the old StdioServerTransport implementation never opened the HTTP port the manifest declared, so containers died at the health check. All 8 tools now annotated readOnlyHint (they are pure functions).
Initial release — format, parse and validate dates, convert between timezones, and add, subtract or compare times
